name: Triangle-free diameter-two graphs on 50 vertices with small maximum degree
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..49 that is triangle-free and has diameter at most two (every pair adjacent or with a common neighbour). Minimize the maximum degree; the optimum is 7. The Moore bound forces maximum degree at least 7 on 50 vertices, and the Hoffman-Singleton graph attains it, so 7 is optimal.

sources.locator: Alan J. Hoffman and Robert R. Singleton, On Moore Graphs with Diameters 2 and 3 (1960). Crossref record inspected; Erdős Problem #133 page inspected: a diameter-two graph of maximum degree d has at most d^2+1 vertices, and constructions of Hanson-Seyffarth and Füredi-Seress bound the growth of the minimum maximum degree. The Moore bound forces maximum degree at least 7 on 50 vertices, and the Hoffman-Singleton graph attains it, so 7 is optimal.
